remoteArchiveExecution.effect: The isolated record reproduces direct ../ traversal in decompress@4.2.1; this fixture did not reproduce the advisory symlink-chain case and confirmed no read/write outside its isolated sandbox. Security clearance is not established. Remote archive/template execution remains disabled; the local authored scaffold does not fetch or execute remote templates.
remoteArchiveExecution.remainingRisk: Taro CLI and dependency audit posture are not declared security-cleared; dependency advisories and third-party declaration diagnostics remain recorded for their assigned review and release gates.

npm emitted deprecation/security advisories, including glob@10.5.0 and unsupported legacy dependencies; this is not a dependency security clearance.
